This is the bridge of an Imperial Star Destroyer.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tschel]], about the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]|<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>}}
'''Shaum Hii''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Tragan Cluster/Legends|Tragan Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
{{Quote|Commander Cody. I haven't seen you since that extraction from Shaum Hii. Excellent operation, if you don't mind me saying.''"<br />"''All in a day's work. Or two days, in that case.|[[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ganch]] and [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]]|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation">''[[The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation]]''</ref>}}
The native [[Kian'thar]] rode [[bentail]]s and herded [[derlac]]s for meat. The planet was discovered [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]]. In [[297 BBY]], the natives began developing strong ties with [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] the planet was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space. The planet had direct representation in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. It was [[Battle of the Shaum Hii system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
